title: Schedule
paragraphs: The Next Day. As usual, Sakura-chan was using Father as a hugging pillow.
“Ugh… It’s so hot…”
“Suu… suu…”
“Whoa! Sakura-san is hugging Naofumi-san!”
A freshly awakened Itsuki rubbed his sleepy eyes and pointed it out.
“Weren’t the Filolials supposed to sleep in the next room?”
Ren, still groggy, sat up and analyzed the situation.
Don’t you understand? Sakura-chan got lonely, so Father showed kindness and let her sleep with him.
“Motoyasu-san, you look like you knew this was coming.”
“Motoyasu, if you knew, you should’ve warned Naofumi first.”
“Sakura-chan did the same thing to Father two loops ago.”
“It’s too late now. If they were up late last night, Naofumi-san must be exhausted too…”
Itsuki gave Father a gentle shake to wake him up.
“Ugh… Huh? What is this!?”
“It’s Sakura-san. Look, Sakura-san, wake up.”
“Nyaaah…”

Even in her sleep, Sakura-chan tried to adjust her sleeping position while still clinging to Father. The inn’s floor creaked under the strain. After all, Sakura-chan was currently in her Filolial Queen form, so she had quite a bit of weight.
“Is the floor going to hold!? Lord Kitamura! We need to separate Lord Iwatani and Lady Sakura before something happens!”
“How did we handle this two loops ago?”
Just as I was trying to recall, Yuki-chan arrived. As always, she carried herself with an air of dignity.
“Good morning, Lord Motoyasu, everyone.”
“Good morning to you as well!”
“What a fine morning… Wait, Sakura! That’s improper behavior! Stop that!”
“Nyaaah…”
“H-Help me!”
“Wasn’t there a scene like this in an old children’s anime? A big creature sleeping with someone lying on its stomach?”
“Oh, so they had that in Ren-san’s world too?”
“Hey! Stop making comparisons and HELP ME!”
With Yuki-chan’s assistance, Sakura-chan reluctantly released Father. She looked quite disappointed.
“Huh? Where’s Kou?”
Now that I thought about it, he was nowhere to be seen.
Maybe he was still outside?
“He went out for a morning walk.”
“Just how free-spirited are these guys…?”
Kou was a gluttonous boy, after all. His sense of adventure must have kicked in.”Phew… Anyway, Sakura-chan, please stop doing this, okay?”
“Why not?”
“The inn is too small, and I get too hot, so I can’t sleep well. If we’re camping outdoors… then maybe, just a little, but try to hold back.”
“Okaaay.”
Father scolded Sakura-chan, while Ren and Itsuki watched in exasperation.
“Or better yet, why don’t you do it to Ren and Itsuki instead?”
“Naofumi, don’t redirect this to us.”
“Exactly. This is your role, Naofumi-san.”
“What role!?”
It seems Ren and Itsuki were getting used to all this, as their reactions were becoming duller. I really wish they wouldn’t force Father into such a weird position.
“So, what’s the plan for today?”
“I’ll be making clothes for Yuki-chan and the others!”
“That means Motoyasu is staying behind again, while we go level up.”
“At this point, we’re getting into a rhythm, so we should be ready to move out soon, right?”
“Yeah… The only issue is who’s going to keep Motoyasu in check…”
Father and the others exchanged looks.
Were they worried I might do something? I don’t recall causing any trouble, though.
“Maybe we should take turns watching over him?”
“We could set a meeting time, or have someone accompany him all day.”
“It’s either dealing with motion sickness or keeping an eye on Motoyasu-san.”
“A disaster either way.”
“That’s harsh… I can’t even deny it. But if I’m left alone, my level growth slows down, and that’s not fair… If it’s just for three days, I wouldn’t mind, though.”
“Honestly, I want to start moving soon. We haven’t run into any real problems, but I feel like we’re starting to attract attention.”
“Then let’s take turns watching over Motoyasu-kun today. Luckily, he’ll be busy making clothes, so he won’t have time to go wild.”
“Wait, is making clothes really that simple?”
Father and the others turned to me.
“If I can turn the thread we spun last night into fabric, I should be able to finish by the end of the day!”
I still remembered the measurements and patterns. Many Filolials have similar body shapes, so it wouldn’t be an issue.
“You’re surprisingly skilled with your hands.”
“Isn’t he just using his level to force his way through?”
“Boosting dexterity, huh? That’s possible.”
“Japanese logic doesn’t really apply in a world with levels, huh?”
“I mean, if we can make potions and other goods with weapons, then it’s not really a problem.”
“Yeah, in MMOs, you can craft things instantly too…”

Father and the others were analyzing Yuki-chan and the others as they observed them. I’ll have proper clothes ready for them by the end of the day. So, there are no plans to go out much today. However, it seems Father and the others want to depart once Yuki-chan’s clothes are finished. One way or another, the distance to Faubrey is quite considerable. According to their conversation, they want to see various places and learn more about the world. If they plan to take detours, the journey will take even longer. Based on estimates, if we rotated the Filolials without resting… The Father from the first world really pushed them hard. If I recall correctly, they reached their destination in about three or four days. But those three days were brutal. Even Filo-tan was pushed to her limits—I, Motoyasu, saw it all and remember it well. The carriage was groaning under the strain too. If we tried that pace with Yuki-chan and the others now, they would definitely collapse. While level-based enhancements could compensate to some extent, considering Father’s opinion, we should be generous with our estimates—one week… No, it would be wiser to plan for a two-week journey.
“Hmm…”
“Faubrey isn’t going anywhere.”
“That’s not exactly what I’m getting at.”

“The real issue is the route to Faubrey. Siltvelt has a lot of mountainous terrain and vast forests. Looking at the map, traveling in a straight line is difficult for Filolials. Not to mention, there’s that massive Labyrinth Desert in the way.”
Éclair added her thoughts. Ah, right. There was that wasteland and desert. That’s the situation when traveling to Faubrey from the Siltvelt side.
“What about from Melromarc?”
“Same problem—mountains, valleys, wastelands, and mountain ranges.”

Now, how did we get through last time? Ah, right—we made Rival grow larger and had them fly over the mountains. I vaguely remember Rival flailing around, complaining through gestures that the carriage was too heavy. Father had commanded it so naturally that he probably didn’t even register the difficulty.
“Crossing the desert, huh…”
“Do you think we can manage it?”
“I’d recommend going around it.”
“It’s not impossible if we push ourselves, but since Father wants to see more of the world, taking a detour is worth considering.”
“Alright, then let’s go with that plan?”
When Father asked Ren and Itsuki, both nodded in agreement. A wasteland and a desert, huh…
Just imagining Filolials galloping across the barren lands fills me with excitement!
“Alright, I’ll keep an eye on Motoyasu-kun until noon. After that, Ren or Itsuki can take over. How does that sound?”
“Got it. We’ll head back around then. We’ll grab a meal somewhere and switch shifts, and by around three, the last person will take over. Once the clothes are finished, we’ll depart.”
“Sounds good. Since Naofumi-san’s watching until noon, who should go next?”
“This is the easiest shift—you get a meal break.”
Ren and Itsuki exchanged sharp glances, preparing to settle it with rock-paper-scissors again.
So they weren’t using a lottery this time?
“Why don’t you both just go hunting until noon and then take the afternoon off?”
